title: An antipathogenic compound that targets the OxyR peroxide sensor in Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
authors: Oh, Hyo-Young; Jalde, Shivakumar S; Chung, In-Young; Yoo, Yeon-Ji; Jang, Hye-Jeong; Choi, Hyun-Kyung; Cho, You-Hee
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过虚拟筛选和分子对接靶向铜绿假单胞菌OxyR过氧化物传感器，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Introduction. Antipathogenic or antivirulence strategy is to target a virulence pathway that is dispensable for growth, in the hope to mitigate the selection for drug resistance.Hypothesis/Gap Statment. Peroxide stress responses are one of the conserved virulence pathways in bacterial pathogens and thus good targets for antipathogenic strategy.Aim. This study aims to identify a new chemical compound that targets OxyR, the peroxide sensor required for the full virulence of the opportunistic human pathogen, Pseudomonas aeruginosa.Methodology. Computer-based virtual screening under consideration of the 'eNTRy' rules and molecular docking were conducted on the reduced form of the OxyR regulatory domain (RD). Selected hits were validated by their ability to phenocopy the oxyR null mutant and modulate the redox cycle of OxyR.Results. We first isolated three robust chemical hits that inhibit OxyR without affecting prototrophic growth or viability. One (compound 1) of those affected the redox cycle of OxyR in response to H(2)O(2) treatment, in a way to impair its function. Compound 1 displayed selective antibacterial efficacy against P. aeruginosa in Drosophila infection model, without antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus.Conclusion. These results suggest that compound 1 could be an antipathogenic hit inhibiting the P. aeruginosa OxyR. More importantly, our study provides an insight into the computer-based discovery of new-paradigm selective antibacterials to treat Gram-negative bacterial infections presumably with few concerns of drug resistance.
abstract_zh: 引言。抗病原性或抗毒力策略旨在靶向对生长非必需的毒力通路，以期减轻药物耐药性的选择压力。假设/缺口陈述。过氧化物应激反应是细菌病原体中保守的毒力通路之一，因此是抗病原性策略的良好靶点。目的。本研究旨在鉴定一种靶向OxyR的新型化合物，OxyR是过氧化物传感器，对机会性人类病原体铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）的完全毒力至关重要。方法。在考虑“eNTRy”规则和分子对接（molecular docking）的基础上，对OxyR调控结构域（regulatory domain, RD）的还原形式进行了基于计算机的虚拟筛选。选中的命中化合物通过其表型复制oxyR缺失突变体及调节OxyR氧化还原循环的能力进行验证。结果。我们首先分离出三个稳健的化学命中化合物，它们在不影响原养型生长或生存力的前提下抑制OxyR。其中一个（化合物1）在响应H(2)O(2)处理时影响OxyR的氧化还原循环，从而损害其功能。化合物1在果蝇感染模型中对铜绿假单胞菌显示出选择性抗菌功效，而对金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）无抗菌活性。结论。这些结果表明，化合物1可能是抑制铜绿假单胞菌OxyR的抗病原性命中化合物。更重要的是，我们的研究为基于计算机发现新范式选择性抗菌药物以治疗革兰氏阴性菌感染提供了见解，这些药物可能对药物耐药性关注较少。
